prompts: A semiconductor wafer map showing a compact cluster of defects around the geometric center with the outer area mostly clear.
Donut: A semiconductor wafer map showing defects forming an interior annular ring around a relatively clear center and away from the outer boundary.
Edge-Loc: A semiconductor wafer map showing a localized cluster of defects touching one limited section of the outer boundary.
Edge-Ring: A semiconductor wafer map showing a broad continuous or nearly continuous ring of defects along the outer boundary of the wafer.
Loc: Wafer with a compact off-center interior cluster of defects that does not touch the boundary
A semiconductor wafer map showing numerous defects scattered randomly across the surface without any consistent pattern.
Scratch: A semiconductor wafer map showing a long, thin defect aligned along a narrow line or streak across part of the wafer.
A semiconductor wafer map showing Near-full defects covering almost all wafer locations with only a small amount of clear area.
